name: Yacht Club at The Boca Raton
insider_take: This waterfront sanctuary perfectly captures Boca Raton's sophisticated coastal charm, where luxury yachting culture meets timeless elegance.
whats_special: The Yacht Club sits on the pristine Boca Raton Resort & Club's waterfront, offering direct access to the Intracoastal Waterway. This exclusive enclave features its own private marina and is part of the legendary Pink Palace resort that has hosted celebrities and dignitaries since 1926. The property's unique positioning allows guests to enjoy both oceanfront luxury and easy yacht access to Palm Beach's exclusive social scene.
pro_tip: Book a sunset cruise from the marina to experience Boca Raton's famous "Golden Hour" views of the Intracoastal, when the sky transforms into brilliant oranges and pinks reflected in the calm waters.
dont_miss: The weekly yacht owner socials at the marina, where you can mingle with South Florida's boating elite. Also explore nearby Mizner Park, designed after Worth Avenue, featuring upscale shopping and dining just minutes from the resort.
pros: Exclusive waterfront location with private marina access
Luxurious yacht club atmosphere with sophisticated amenities
Prime Boca Raton location near upscale shopping and dining
cons: Premium pricing reflects exclusive yacht club positioning
May appeal primarily to boating enthusiasts and luxury travelers
